Key Findings

  • Initial access via a student portal vulnerability.
  • Domain admin from a service account with a password unchanged since 2017.
  • Research shares and finance on the same flat network as student labs.
  • Backups on network storage joined to the domain.

Data Obtained

  • Student records, transcripts and financial aid files
  • Staff HR and payroll
  • Research grant applications
  • Finance and procurement
  • Active Directory and IT documentation
